CustomField.description: Command Center logic, Closing window card: days from today to the Opportunity Close Date. Past due, Next 30 days, 31 to 60, 61 to 90, Later (also blank close date).
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Opportunity__r.CloseDate), "5. Later", IF(Opportunity__r.CloseDate < TODAY(), "1. Past due", IF(Opportunity__r.CloseDate - TODAY() <= 30, "2. Next 30 days", IF(Opportunity__r.CloseDate - TODAY() <= 60, "3. 31 to 60 days", IF(Opportunity__r.CloseDate - TODAY() <= 90, "4. 61 to 90 days", "5. Later")))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Command Center: Closing window. Days from today to the Opportunity Close Date.
CustomField.label: CC: Closing window
